title: The Old Ground Demon Ghost
summary: Xiao Yan's new Bone Wings push the Purple Cloud Wings out of his body. Han Feng tells the Old Ground Demon Ghost that Xiao Yan killed Fang Yan and two other elders of Demon Flame Valley. The Old Ground Demon Ghost breaks into the Inner Academy of Jia Nan Academy and demands Xiao Yan from Su Qian, now a Dou Zong. Su Qian accuses him of really wanting the Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva and says Dean Mang Tian Chi would stop him. Han Feng takes on Su Qian, and the students are sent to safety. Xiao Yan and Little Fairy Doctor fight the Old Ground Demon Ghost, a Seven-Star Dou Zong, with fire, poison and the Sea Flipping Seal. Little Fairy Doctor unleashes the Woeful Poison Body and rises to Five-Star Dou Zong strength to buy Xiao Yan time. The Old Ground Demon Ghost shrugs off her poisoned blood and keeps coming.

introduced: Mang Tian Chi (dean of Jia Nan Academy, named only)
cultivation: Su Qian has advanced from peak Dou Huang to Dou Zong. The Old Ground Demon Ghost is a Seven-Star Dou Zong. Little Fairy Doctor is called a Four-Star Dou Zong, and at most Five-Star after unleashing the Woeful Poison Body.
